heading: Short title, and Commencement
title: Short title, and Commencement
text:
1. Short title, and Commencement.___(1) This Ordinance may be called the National Development Volunteer Programme (Repeal) Ordinance, 1980.

(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the first day of June, 1980.
